title: Everyone bowed.
paragraphs:
Not because it was easy.
Because they had already decided who they belonged to.
What is one thing you refuse to bow to?

The crowd bowed.
The music played.
The pressure was real.

Sometimes faith isn’t loud.
It’s just the quiet strength to stand when everyone else folds.

Pressure reveals what we already decided in private.
What’s one value you won’t compromise? 👇
